message.content: {"action":"check","sql":"SELECT accounts_304.id, COALESCE(events_304.state, 'NONE') AS state FROM accounts_304 JOIN (SELECT account_id, MAX(at) AS max_at FROM events_304 WHERE at <= 5 GROUP BY account_id) AS latest_event ON accounts_304.id = latest_event.account_id JOIN events_304 ON events_304.account_id = latest_event.account_id AND events_304.at = latest_event.max_at AND events_304.at <= 5 WHERE accounts_304.active = 1 ORDER BY accounts_304.id;"}
